WITH film_copies AS (
  SELECT 
    f.film_id,
    f.rating,
    COUNT(i.inventory_id) as copies
  FROM inventory i
  JOIN film f ON f.film_id = i.film_id
  GROUP BY f.film_id, f.rating
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(CAST(copies AS FLOAT)) as avg_copies
  FROM film_copies
),
rating_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    rating,
    AVG(CAST(copies AS FLOAT)) as avg_copies
  FROM film_copies
  GROUP BY rating
)
SELECT 
  fc.film_id,
  fc.rating,
  fc.copies,
  fc.copies - ra.avg_copies as diff_from_rating_avg,
  fc.copies - oa.avg_copies as diff_from_overall_avg
FROM film_copies fc
CROSS JOIN overall_avg oa
JOIN rating_avg ra ON ra.rating = fc.rating
ORDER BY diff_from_overall_avg DESC
LIMIT 10
